sloka: तस्याः प्रसन्नो ब्रह्मर्षिर् ददौ ब्राह्मम् अनुत्तमम् ।ब्रह्मदत्त इति ख्यातम् मानसम् चूलिनः सुतम् ॥१-३३-१८॥
transliteration: tasyāḥ prasanno brahmarṣir dadau brāhmam anuttamam ।brahmadatta iti khyātam mānasam cūlinaḥ sutam ॥1-33-18॥

translations.english: Pleased with her, brahmarshi Chuli gave her an excellent son to be wellknown as Brahmadatta born through the will of his mind.
